summary: Practise health service mapping, continuity planning, referral pathways, and response reporting. Explore this five-day foundation course.
lede: Humanitarian health program management helps health program officers and response managers organize essential services during emergencies. Participants practise mapping service availability and gaps, planning continuity and referral pathways, and reviewing workforce readiness and service quality. They also use routine indicators and partner coverage information to prepare operational updates as access, staffing, and needs change.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who plan, coordinate, or monitor health service delivery during humanitarian response and need practical ways to manage continuity, quality, staffing, and referrals.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with health-service delivery or humanitarian response is useful. No coding or programming is required.
